integrity_notes: All mathematical limit statements are established analytically in RESULT.md; finite exact enumeration and Monte Carlo in verify.py are independent supplementary checks and are not asserted as infinite proofs. Earliest motivating 2019 journal publication independently date-verified; later archived manuscript date is not substituted for original publication.
limitations: Stationary symmetric binary Markov environment with 0<p<1; positive two-stage starting population; off-diagonal semelparous matrices; even-year CLT; no finite-population or density dependence. Endpoint switching probabilities and one-zero-cohort starts excluded. Results are self-reviewed, not independently audited.
title: A non-Gaussian age-cohort risk law under correlated environments
